hits.text: Read-only mathematics on the frozen actual REFAN + AXIS_PARETO mesh. No native/API/browser job, production source, mesh point, numerical threshold or acceptance state was changed by this audit. CPU affinity was 36–39, one BLAS/OpenMP thread and CUDA hidden. Exact source-trace and written-polyMesh hashes are in the raw audit.

Three geometry-selected, same-rank complete original-parent stencils were searched. Two retained internal-AP proposals improve determinant and nonorthogonality while passing the complete local geometry/conservation and five-metric Pareto guards. **None satisfies all five absolute stock thresholds.** A third supported parent has no meaningful retained improvement; three other representatives are refused because their coupled exterior geometry is unavailable.

Fast iterations compute the actual selected-face area-tensor determinant, each affected interface's weight/ratio/skew/nonorthogonality, and original-plane margins. Old passing roles must remain passing; original worst failed severity cannot worsen. Candidate construction uses the existing geometry-derived W/R/N proposal rows. A floating LP or nonlinear solver success is only a proposal. Each solved point and generic 0.25/0.5/0.75 blends from the actual AP is rechecked by the full original stencil evaluator: positive volumes/pyramids/tet fans, closure, plane/polygon support, face-centre predicate, point clearance, parent volume/first moment and all five actual Pareto metrics. Relative D improvement must exceed 1e-8, so a one-ULP change is not reported as progress.

No search infeasibility result proves all APs or topologies impossible. The local fixed-point clearance does not establish all native point clearance. Coupled remote geometry is refused rather than invented; full cyclic/processor and installed stock quality remain separate native gates. The original threshold and 300 s whole-job deadline are unchanged. Neither a partial Pareto improvement nor a successful optimizer status is mesh acceptance.

Each ideal uses the actual triangle/inward direction. Original planes with the 3 um guard clip the current-to-ideal segment; four bounded blends follow. All children, fixed external CC/V, affected faces, D/W/R/S/N Pareto counts/labels/worst severity, positive geometry and V/M1, and full-rank existing-point clearance are evaluated.

Six physical-side representatives give 24 trials. Only rank 3 parent 10906 blend .25 passes local no-new Pareto/geometry: Dmin improves about 4.13e-6 to 6.34e-6 but four bad D remain. This is partial severity improvement, not repaired geometry. Rank 4 parent 26710 reduces D/N bad counts but is refused because worst N rises. All-four selected-face data: three representatives, twelve trials, none accepted.

The joint frozen parents r3/9731, r3/9732 and r3/9885 have local candidates satisfying all five Pareto criteria. For r3/9731, 35 children and 92 affected faces give Dmin=0.0052163, Wmin=0.0960844, Rmin=0.106298 and maxSkew=0.940677. This is local offline geometry, not a native mesh PASS.

In the later 13-proposal frozen mesh, r3/9777 and r3/9792 remove their local low W/R faces, but increase the worst pre-existing nonorthogonality despite fewer bad labels. They remain refused by the full Pareto rule. r3/9836 creates a new bad nonorthogonal face; r3/621818 creates new bad determinant cells and a bad nonorthogonal face. These counterexamples are retained.

The output command paths stay inside this repository. Global all-source-point separation, unknown coupled neighbours, native serialization/canonicalization, every original geometry/Pareto condition, full stock checker and total 300s mesh deadline remain production gates.

Final six-ratio follow-up uses the later frozen quality-kernel mesh. Its complete eight-rank lowVolRatioFaces sets contain six faces, all bound to the native parent/base trace and independently recalculated below 0.01. Four concern r3/9836: a W/R proposal again creates bad nonorthogonal face 1467321 and is refused. Two concern r1/652847 against fixed external parents 25236 and 46412. The exact planar ten-child model gives a two-row rational contradiction: neighbour-weight constraints on faces 37870 and 88011 require AP.x<=2.1343514837566175m and AP.x>=2.1421894736842106m. Moving this parent apex alone cannot satisfy both. Joint neighbour motion or topology changes remain possible and require full validation.
The frozen 920f quality-kernel identity matches the seven quad height-cap certificates. Labels are not reused against later topology.
This is a read-only mathematical audit of the frozen 920f quality-kernel mesh.

The already committed input in ../cone-quality-kernel/final-ratio-parents-input.json supplies rank 3, source parent 9836: all 36 children and 94 affected faces, including their fixed external neighbour geometry. Only the internal shared apex moves mathematically. The entire 744-row W/R/kernel system and 735 added angle rows are retained in parent9836-analysis.json.

Three generic proposals pass every local absolute quality threshold, every local five-metric Pareto gate and the geometry/volume/moment checks. Four near-original blends are valid partial improvements but retain a determinant below .001; they are not called all-quality passes. The external neighbours themselves may have pre-existing unaffected determinant failures: this result covers the 36 children and 94 affected interfaces, not an assertion that every external cell or the entire mesh passes.
